title: Water system service plans and spare parts | Aquemi
meta: Named service plans with stated response times, preventive maintenance, USP <645> and <643> instrument calibration, critical spares and emergency response.
headline: Keep the system in its qualified state, on a plan you can read
lead: Choose a service plan with stated response times and a fixed scope. Every visit ends with a signed report your quality unit can file, and every calibration carries a certificate.

rows: Instrument calibration (conductivity, TOC, temperature, pressure, flow)
Critical spares kit held for you
Annual system health report and trend review

blocks.h: What a preventive maintenance visit covers

items.d: Conductivity, total organic carbon (TOC), pressures and temperatures since the last visit, before any work starts.
Reverse osmosis (RO) normalized performance, cleaning when needed, electrodeionization (EDI) checks.
Replaced on a documented schedule, with lot numbers recorded.
Replacement and integrity testing of hydrophobic vent filters.
Lamp hours, intensity, ozone generator output and destruct checks.
Temperature or ozone concentration confirmed at the far end of the loop.

rows.v: Cell constant verified with a traceable standard; temperature sensor checked
Comparison against a calibrated reference at operating and sanitization temperature
Comparison against calibrated references across range

items.d: An engineer answers at [phone number], [hours]. You describe the symptom; we ask for the alarm history.
Where remote access is approved, we review trends with you within [time].
A technician with the likely parts is on site within your plan's response time.
We restore operation, record what changed and give you the input your change control needs.

body: Each system ships with a recommended spares list ranked by criticality: parts whose failure stops production, parts with long lead times, and routine consumables.
We hold stock for Aquemi systems at [stocking location]. We use standard, non-proprietary membranes, EDI modules and instruments where possible, so you are not locked into a single source.

items: Signed service report for every visit
Calibration certificates, traceable to national standards
Annual system health report with trends

items.q: Do you service other manufacturers' systems?
items.a: Yes. We start with a condition survey and document review, then offer a plan for that system.

items.q: Will service work affect our qualified state?
items.a: Like-for-like replacement under a documented procedure normally does not. Anything else goes through your change control, and we give you the information to assess it.
[Service regions]. Outside them we work through [partner network or travel terms].

cta.body: Tell us your system and its age, and we return plan pricing and a first-visit scope.
